value.rationale: The 2026 convex-body Galerkin construction makes irredundancy and generator structure natural optimization questions. This result supplies a complete H/V characterization of the planar vertex parameter cone, a dimension-2n-2 translation quotient, a precise description of every extreme direction, and a parity-sensitive closed cubic ray count for all regular normal arrays. Unlike a single routine reduction, the full count measures a natural feasible cone’s optimization geometry.
